name: Terry Davis Bird Quote
aliases: when my bird was looking at my computer monitor
maybe that's the best you can do
description: Terry Davis in sunglasses and a grey pullover in his room, next to his quote: "What's reality? I don't know. When my bird was looking at my computer monitor I thought 'That bird has no idea what he's looking at.' ... Maybe you have some bird ideas. Maybe that's the best you can do."
usage: Humility about not understanding the world, or gently telling someone their take is a bird idea. Also used as wholesome Terry wisdom.
